text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst Guillermo Arbe said on Thursday he had cut his rating for Peruvian precious metals company Buenaventura Mining Co Inc to hold from buy.
-- He said 1996 earnings had been revised down to $23.6 million, while 1997 and 1998 forecasts have been cut to $25.7 million and $30.4 million respectively.

-- "The new estimates mainly take account of lower yearly average gold price assumptions of $375 (an ounce) in 1997 and $380 (an ounce) in 1998," he wrote. Previous estimates were for $390 for both years.
-- "Based on a less positive outlook for gold and our earnings per share revisions, we have downgraded our recommendation on Buenaventura to a hold."
-- The company's shares were off 1/4 to 16-5/8 in New York.
